text:
erin: Heads-up: geo-wave deploy tomorrow 02:30 UTC. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Need final capacity snapshot + pin decisions. @deploy-bot scheduled smoke at 02:05 UTC. Please ack.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary in us-west-2 at 02:30 (slice=10%). Warmup at 02:10, smoke tests at 02:05. Runbook: /deploys/geo-wave. Will post results automatically. :rocket:

sam: ACK — I'll run capacity snapshot at 02:00 and post numbers.

leo: Suggest pinning model v2.3.1 for EU for 45m. EU latency profile is spiky on v2.3.2; better to keep v2.3.1 as fallback.

anita: Dedicated pools report (quick): total GPUs=240, warmpool=60, free=42 right now. We can reserve 20 for canaries across regions without impacting baseline.

cassie: Ops note: per-tenant quota is at ~85% in eu-west-1 currently — risk of throttle during ramp. Recommend softpin EU traffic to 80% for first 15m post-cutover.

sam: Snapshot: free GPUs by zone (02:00 forecast) — us-west-2: 90, us-east-1: 50, eu-west-1: 40, ap-southeast-1: 60. Reserving 20 for canaries leaves cushion ~220 total.

erin: Rollback criteria proposal: error rate >0.8% sustained for 3m OR p99 latency increase >300ms vs baseline for 5m -> immediate rollback and route 100% to previous pinned model. Also escalate to oncall. Confirm?

leo: Confirm. Also add model-quality regression trigger: token-divergence >8% on smoke evals -> rollback.

cassie: I'll set EU softpin to 80% and enable automatic fallback route to v2.2.9-quantized if free GPUs in EU drop below 30 during ramp.

anita: FYI APAC has a network maintenance window 03:00-03:30 UTC; avoid any heavy scaling activity then. We'll plan warmpool ops outside that window.

sam: Acknowledged. If APAC free GPUs <35 at 02:00 I'll request we delay APAC promotion and keep it pinned to previous version.

erin: Final asks: @maria (oncall) please standby during US->EU handoff (02:35-02:55 UTC). @deploy-bot will post canary results and metrics. I'll draft release-note snippet after successful smoke. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: canary results posted: us-west-2 canary OK (err=0.12%, p99 +10ms). Promoting to EU slice at 02:40 per sequence. Smoke logs: https://deploys.internal/geo-wave/1809991234/canary (internal).

maria: Oncall here — watching handoff window and alerts. I've set up monitors for err_rate, p99, and the model-quality eval hook.

erin: Thanks everyone. Sam — paste final snapshot and confirm pins when ready.
